Search By Title (FREE).name: Search By Title (FREE)
Search By Title (FREE).description:
Search By Title (FREE) is a precise tool designed to find movies and series by their titles. It retrieves up to 20 results by default, ensuring that each item has a 100% match with the specified title. If more than 20 items match exactly, all matching results will be displayed without pagination support. This tool is ideal for quickly locating specific titles within a large database, providing an efficient solution for users seeking exact matches.

Parameters Description:
- Maximum amount of items returned are 20, unless there are more than 20 shows with the exact given title input. In that case, all items that have a 100% match with the title will be returned.
- No pagination is supported.

required_parameters.name: title
required_parameters.description: Title to search for.

required_parameters.name: country
required_parameters.description: Regardless of this value, the given title is searched across all the platforms and all the countries. This parameter determines according to which country the streamingInfo field will be populated. Thus even if a show is not available in this country, It will be included in the results if it resembles with the given title, but the streaming information will not be available.

optional_parameters.name: show_type
optional_parameters.description: Type of shows to include in the results. Either `movie`, `series` or `all`. Default is `all`.

optional_parameters.name: output_language
optional_parameters.description: 2 letter iso code of the output language. Default is `en`. See the about page to see the list of languages supported.

required_parameters.name: services
required_parameters.description:
A comma separated list of up to 8 services to search in. See `/v2/services` endpoint to get the supported services and their ids/names.

Syntax of the values supplied in the list can be as the followings:

`<sevice_id>`: Searches in the entire catalog of that service, including (if applicable) rentable, buyable shows or shows available through addons i.e. `netflix`, `prime`, `apple`

`<sevice_id>.<offer_type>`: Only returns the shows that are available in that service with the given offer type. Valid offer type values are `subscription`, `free`, `rent`, `buy` and `addon`  i.e. `peacock.free` only returns the shows on Peacock that are free to watch, `prime.subscription` only returns the shows on Prime Video that are available to watch with a Prime subscription. `hulu.addon` only returns the shows on Hulu that are available via an addon,  `prime.rent` only returns the shows on Prime Video that are rentable.

`<sevice_id>.addon.<addon_id>`: Only returns the shows that are available in that service with the given addon. Check `/v2/services` endpoint to fetch the available addons for a service. Some sample values are: `hulu.addon.hbo`,  `prime.addon.hbomaxus`.

If a service supports both `free` and `subscription`, then results included under `subscription` will always include the `free` shows as well.

When multiple values are passed as a comma separated list, any show that satisfies at least one of the values will be included in the result.

Some sample list values:

`prime.rent,prime.buy,apple.rent,apple.buy`: Returns all the buyable/rentable shows on Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV.

`prime.addon,prime.subscription`: Returns all the shows on Amazon Prime Video that are available through either a Prime Video subscription or a Prime Video Channel subscription.

optional_parameters.name: year_max
optional_parameters.description: Maximum release/air year of the show.

optional_parameters.name: cursor
optional_parameters.description:
Cursor is used for pagination. After each request, the response includes a `hasMore` boolean field to tell if there are more results that did not fit the returned list size. If it is set as true, to get the rest of the result set, send a new request (with the same parameters for other fields such as show_type, services etc.), and set the cursor parameter as the `nextCursor` value of the previous request response. Do not forget to escape the cursor value before putting it into the query as it might contain characters such as `?`, `&`.

The first request naturally does not require a `cursor` parameter.

optional_parameters.name: desc
optional_parameters.description:
Use descending order?

Possible values are `true` and `false`. Default value is `false`.

optional_parameters.name: genres_relation
optional_parameters.description:
When more than one genre is supplied in `genres` parameter, `genres_relation` chooses the matching style against

When `or`, the endpoint returns any show that has at least one of the given genres.
When `and`, it only returns the shows that have all of the given genres.

Default value is `and`.

optional_parameters.name: year_min
optional_parameters.description: Minimum release/air year of the show.

optional_parameters.name: show_original_language
optional_parameters.description: A 2 letter ISO 639-1 language code to only search within the shows whose original language matches with the provided language.

optional_parameters.name: genres
optional_parameters.description:
Comma separated list of genre ids to only search within the shows in those genres. See `/v2/genres` endpoint to see available genres and ids.

When more than one genre supplied, set `genres_relation` parameter to specify between returning shows that have at least one of the given genres or returning shows that have all of the given genres

optional_parameters.name: show_type
optional_parameters.description: Type of shows to search in. Accepted values are `movie`, `series` or `all`. The default value is `all`.

optional_parameters.name: order_by
optional_parameters.description:
Determines the ordering of the results.

Possible values are `original_title` and `year`. Default value is `original_title`

optional_parameters.name: output_language
optional_parameters.description: 2 letter iso code of the output language. Default is `en`. See the about page to see the list of languages supported.

optional_parameters.name: keyword
optional_parameters.description: A keyword to only search within the shows have that keyword in their overview or title.

Genres.name: Genres

- `genre_id`: The internal ID for the genre.

Titles with Changed Sources.description: This tool provides a comprehensive listing of movie and series titles that have undergone changes in their streaming sources within a specified date range. It allows users to track updates in streaming availability, ensuring they have the most current information on where to find their favorite content. Ideal for keeping up with the dynamic nature of online streaming platforms, this tool supports queries based on genres, release dates, and specific regions, making it an essential resource for both casual viewers and industry professionals.

optional_parameters.name: start_date
optional_parameters.description: By default, the changes API will return changes since the beginning of yesterday. Populate this parameter to manually set a start date to include changes from a specific date range, format is YYYYMMDD (eg 20210101 for January 1st, 2021), or for more granular results down to the second YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (eg 20210101123459 for January 1st, 2021 12:24pm and 59 seconds). Hours are in 24 hour format and in Eastern Standard Time. Month, day, hour, minutes and seconds use leading zeros for single digit values.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: Set how many titles to return per page, default and maximum is 250.

optional_parameters.name: end_date
optional_parameters.description: By default, the changes API will return changes since the beginning of yesterday. Populate this parameter to manually set a end date to include changes from a specific date range, format is YYYYMMDD (eg 20210101 for January 1st, 2021), or for more granular results down to the second YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (eg 20210101123459 for January 1st, 2021 12:24pm and 59 seconds). Hours are in 24 hour format and in Eastern Standard Time. Month, day, hour, minutes and seconds use leading zeros for single digit values.

optional_parameters.name: regions
optional_parameters.description: Pass in the 2 character region code (eg US) for the country you want to get titles with changed sources from. There is a limit to 1 region on this endpoint, if you leave this field blank US changes will be returned only.

optional_parameters.name: types
optional_parameters.description: Filter result to only include certain types of titles. Pass a single type or pass multiple types comma delimited. Possible values: movie, tv_series, tv_special, tv_miniseries, short_film

optional_parameters.name: page
optional_parameters.description: Set the page of results you want to return, if this isn't set you will always get page 1 returned.

Streaming Release Dates.name: Streaming Release Dates
Streaming Release Dates.description:
The Streaming Release Dates tool provides an up-to-date listing of movies and TV shows recently released or soon to be released on major streaming platforms such as Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, and Disney+. It features an 'is_original' field to indicate whether the content is an exclusive original release of the respective streaming service. The tool supports queries for US release dates, with most content released simultaneously across supported countries. Users can search for specific genres, years, and ratings to find tailored streaming options. This tool is ideal for viewers looking to stay current with the latest streaming content available in their region.

Note: The tool's response includes crucial details like title, streaming service availability, and release dates, ensuring users have all the necessary information to plan their watching schedule effectively.

optional_parameters.name: start_date
optional_parameters.description: By default, this endpoint will return release dates from the current date through the next 30 days. Populate this parameter to manually set a start date to include releases from a specific date range, format is YYYYMMDD (eg 20210101 for January 1st, 2021), or for more granular results down to the second YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (eg 20210101123459 for January 1st, 2021 12:24pm and 59 seconds). Hours are in 24 hour format and in Eastern Standard Time. Month, day, hour, minutes and seconds use leading zeros for single digit values.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: Set how many release dates to return, default is 500.

optional_parameters.name: end_date
optional_parameters.description: By default, this endpoint will return release dates from the current date through the next 30 days. Populate this parameter to manually set a end date to include releases from a specific date range, format is YYYYMMDD (eg 20210101 for January 1st, 2021), or for more granular results down to the second YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (eg 20210101123459 for January 1st, 2021 12:24pm and 59 seconds). Hours are in 24 hour format and in Eastern Standard Time. Month, day, hour, minutes and seconds use leading zeros for single digit values.

Title Streaming Sources.name: Title Streaming Sources
Title Streaming Sources.description: Title Streaming Sources provides comprehensive access to streaming availability information for movies and TV shows across various platforms within the USA. Users can retrieve direct links to stream titles on web, iOS, and Android devices. For free users, the service is limited to USA-only sources, while paid users can access deep links for a more integrated viewing experience. The tool supports queries for streaming services offering specific titles, including HD availability, and also provides detailed metadata such as plot, release date, and cast information.

required_parameters.name: id
required_parameters.description:
This ID can be the Watchmode ID of the title (returned by other endpoints such as the list-titles endpoint), or found in the mapping file: https://api.watchmode.com/datasets/title_id_map.csv.

You can also pass an IMDB ID here instead, or a TMDB type and TMDB ID combination. For example, the TMDB combination for The Shawshank Redemption is movie-278 and for Breaking Bad is tv-1396.

Title Seasons.name: Title Seasons
Title Seasons.description: Title Seasons is a versatile tool designed to provide detailed information about TV shows and mini-series. It not only lists all the seasons of a show but also offers extensive data including cast, plot summaries, streaming availability in specific regions, and other relevant metadata like reviews and ratings. This tool is ideal for users looking to explore comprehensive details about their favorite shows, ensuring they have all the information needed to enhance their viewing experience.

This ID can be the Watchmode ID of the title (returned by other endpoints such as the list-titles endpoint), or found in the mapping file: https://api.watchmode.com/datasets/title_id_map.csv.

You can also pass an IMDB ID here instead, or a TMDB type and TMDB ID combination. For example, the TMDB combination for The Shawshank Redemption is movie-278 and for Breaking Bad is tv-1396.

Title Cast & Crew.name: Title Cast & Crew
Title Cast & Crew.description: Title Cast & Crew: Retrieve comprehensive details of all individuals associated with a specific film or television title, including actors (cast) and production team members (crew) such as directors, writers, and cinematographers. For more granular information about any individual, utilize the person-id with the /person/ endpoint. This tool is ideal for gaining in-depth insights into the personnel involved in the creation of entertainment content.

Networks.name: Networks
Networks.description: The "Networks" tool provides an extensive listing of TV networks available through the /title endpoint. It is designed to help users identify which networks offer specific titles, facilitating easier access to desired content. This tool is essential for users looking to streamline their search for TV shows and movies across various networks. Whether you are researching availability or planning viewing schedules, this tool offers a reliable source for network-related queries.

New Titles.name: New Titles
New Titles.description: The New Titles tool efficiently identifies and lists new titles added to Watchmode within a specified date range. This tool is ideal for users seeking to discover the latest additions and can be combined with the /v1/title/ endpoint for detailed information on each title. Use this tool to stay updated on the latest content across various streaming services supported by Watchmode.

Autocomplete Search.name: Autocomplete Search
Autocomplete Search.description: Autocomplete Search: Rapidly locate movie titles and individual names using partial or full input. Ideal for creating autocomplete features, this tool not only identifies titles and people but also categorizes results as either a 'title' or 'person'. For movies, it returns an image of the movie poster, and for individuals, a headshot is provided. This streamlined search capability enhances user experience by delivering quick, visually enriched results.

required_parameters.name: search_value
required_parameters.description: The phrase to search for, can be a full title or person name, or a partial phrase. For example searching for \"The sha\" will find the movie \"The Shawshank Redemption\".

optional_parameters.name: search_type
optional_parameters.description: Set this to 1 to include titles and people in results. Set this to 2 to include titles only. Set this to 3 to include movies only. Set this to 4 to include TV only. Set this to 5 to include people only. By default this is set to 1.

Sources.name: Sources
Sources.description:
Sources is a comprehensive tool that provides a detailed listing of all streaming sources supported by Watchmode. Users can efficiently filter these sources by type, such as subscription-based, free, or others, to tailor the results to their specific viewing preferences. This tool is ideal for users seeking to identify available streaming platforms for various content types within specific regions or based on access type.

Parameters Description:
- Optional: `type` (string) - Specifies the type of streaming source to filter by, such as 'subscription', 'free', etc.

optional_parameters.name: regions
optional_parameters.description: Pass one of the region values (eg. US), or multiple regions comma delimited to only return sources active in those regions. Currently supported regions: US, GB, CA, AU

optional_parameters.name: types
optional_parameters.description:
Pass one of the following values, or multiple comma separated values to only return certain types of streaming sources:
sub, free, purchase, tve. \\\"sub\\\" means the service is a subscription service, \\\"tve\\\" means the service is a TV channel app.

Search.name: Search
Search.description:
The Search tool efficiently locates titles and individuals across various external databases such as IMDB and TheMovieDB.org. Users can search by either external IDs or names to retrieve comprehensive arrays of results, including titles or people. Each result includes essential identifiers necessary for further interactions with our API endpoints. This tool is particularly helpful for obtaining Watchmode IDs, which can then be utilized in other API functionalities to access detailed information and perform more complex queries.
Parameters Description: Utilize `search_value` to specify the search term (e.g., 'Breaking Bad') and `search_field` to define the type of search (e.g., 'name'). The tool returns an array of result objects related to the query, which can be titles or individuals, depending on the search parameters set.

required_parameters.name: search_field
required_parameters.description:
The field for us to search in, either a 3rd party ID or \\\"name\\\" which will search for a movie/show title or a person's name depending on the type(s) set. Must be one of the following options:
imdb_id, tmdb_person_id, tmdb_movie_id, tmdb_tv_id, name.

required_parameters.name: search_value
required_parameters.description: The value we should search for. For example, if you set search_field to imdb_id, this would be the IMDB title/person ID, eg. tt0944947.

optional_parameters.name: types
optional_parameters.description:
Pass one of the following values, or multiple comma separated values to only return certain types:
tv, movie, person.

List Titles.name: List Titles
List Titles.description:
List Titles: Discover and Access Detailed Information on Movies and TV Shows

This enhanced tool allows you to efficiently search and retrieve comprehensive listings of movies and TV shows based on a variety of customizable parameters. Whether you're looking for specific genres, streaming availability in different regions, or detailed information like cast and synopsis, this tool provides targeted results to meet your needs. Ideal for users seeking to explore available titles on platforms like Netflix and Amazon Prime within the USA, it supports refined searches that can include filters for genre, release years, and specific streaming services.

Key Features:
- Advanced search capabilities that allow for granular queries such as "Horror Movies Streaming on Netflix in the USA".
- Access to a wide range of details including title, streaming service, availability, cast, ratings, and synopses.
- Pagination support that handles large datasets effectively, returning up to 250 pages per query.
- Specialized endpoints for users on free plans with streaming source data limited to the USA.

This tool is perfect for developers aiming to integrate comprehensive media title searches into their applications, providing both broad overviews and detailed metadata for an extensive range of titles available across multiple regions and platforms.

optional_parameters.name: genres
optional_parameters.description: Filter results to only include certain genre(s). Pass in a single genre id (which you would get from the /v1/genres/ endpoint, or multiple comma separated.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: Set how many titles to return per page, default and maximum is 250.

optional_parameters.name: source_ids
optional_parameters.description:
Pass an individual ID for a source (returned from the /sources/ endpoint) to filter the results to titles available on that source. Pass multiple values comma separated to return titles available on one of the sources you pass in.
Note: If you populate this you can only set a single region, and if you set no region US will be set by default.

optional_parameters.name: source_types
optional_parameters.description:
Filter results to only include titles that are available on a specific type(s) of source (such a subscription, or TV Everywhere channel apps, etc). By default all are selected, pass one or multiple (comma delimited) of these values: sub, rent, buy, free, tve
Note: If you populate this you can only set a single region, and if you set no region US will be set by default.

optional_parameters.name: types
optional_parameters.description: Filter result to only include certain types of titles. Pass a single type or pass multiple types comma delimited. Possible values: movie, tv_series, tv_special, tv_miniseries, short_film

optional_parameters.name: regions
optional_parameters.description:
Pass one of the region values (eg. US), or multiple regions comma delimited to only return sources active in those regions. Currently supported regions: US, GB, CA, AU
Note: If you populate the source_ids or source_types you can only set a single region, and if you set no region US will be set by default.

optional_parameters.name: sort_by
optional_parameters.description: Sort order of results, possible values: relevance_desc, relevance_asc, popularity_desc, popularity_asc, release_date_desc, release_date_asc, title_desc, title_asc. Default value is: relevance_desc.

optional_parameters.name: page
optional_parameters.description: Set the page of results you want to return, if this isn't set you will always get page 1 returned.

optional_parameters.name: network_ids
optional_parameters.description: Pass an individual ID for a TV network (returned from the /networks/ endpoint) to filter the results to titles the originally aired on that TV network. Pass multiple values comma separated to return titles that aired on one of the networks you passed in.

optional_parameters.name: release_date_start
optional_parameters.description: Set the start of a range for when the title was released (the initial release of the movie or show, not necessarily when it was released on a streaming service). For example, to only include releases on or after January 1, 2001 set this to 20010101

optional_parameters.name: release_date_end
optional_parameters.description: Set the end of a range for when the title was released (the initial release of the movie or show, not necessarily when it was released on a streaming service). For example, to only include releases on or before December 11, 2020 set this to 20201211

Title Details.name: Title Details
Title Details.description:
Title Details is a robust tool designed to fetch detailed information about movies, series, or shows using the Watchmode universal ID. It provides extensive data including streaming availability in specified regions, main cast members, plot summaries, release dates, and additional metadata. This tool caters to users seeking in-depth details about titles for viewing or analytical purposes.

Key Features:
- Fetch streaming availability across various services in specified regions.
- Access detailed metadata such as cast, plot, release date, and more.
- Utilize the Watchmode universal ID for precise search results.

This enhanced description outlines the tool's capabilities more comprehensively, ensuring users understand its full potential and the breadth of information it can provide.

required_parameters.name: id
required_parameters.description:
This ID can be the Watchmode ID of the title (returned by other endpoints such as the list-titles endpoint), or found in the mapping file: https://api.watchmode.com/datasets/title_id_map.csv.

You can also pass an IMDB ID here instead, or a TMDB type and TMDB ID combination. For example, the TMDB combination for The Shawshank Redemption is movie-278 and for Breaking Bad is tv-1396.

optional_parameters.name: language
optional_parameters.description: Two letter iso_639_1 language code. Return the title and plot overview in the language of your choosing (default is EN). If this is set, and not to EN, then an additional field called english_title will be returned with the title in English if available.

Advanced Search.name: Advanced Search
Advanced Search.description: The Advanced Search tool allows users to comprehensively search for movies or TV shows using a variety of parameters including release year, IMDb rating, genre, and language. It provides detailed information such as streaming availability, cast details, and synopses, helping users locate and learn about specific titles across multiple streaming platforms in different regions. This tool is designed to offer precise search capabilities to enhance user experience in finding and accessing content.

New Arrivals.name: New Arrivals
New Arrivals.description:
Discover the latest movies and TV shows across multiple streaming platforms with the New Arrivals tool. This versatile tool not only identifies recent additions but also allows users to filter by genre, year, and streaming service. Additionally, it provides detailed information about specific titles, including streaming availability, cast, crew, and other relevant metadata. Whether you're looking for a specific type of movie or just browsing new content, New Arrivals makes it easy to stay updated and informed about the latest streaming options.

This enhanced description clarifies the tool's capabilities and the breadth of information it can provide, making it easier for users to understand how to utilize the tool effectively for their specific needs.

Basic Info.name: Basic Info
Basic Info.description: The Basic Info tool provides comprehensive details about movies, TV shows, and cast members. It retrieves information such as names, professions, birth and death years, biographies, posters, and notable titles. This tool is ideal for users seeking in-depth background information and visual content related to entertainment figures and media products. It supports queries for specific details and offers a rich dataset for enhancing user knowledge about the entertainment industry.

This endpoint is designed to efficiently search for movies or TV shows by title. It allows users to retrieve detailed information including streaming availability, cast, plot, and other relevant metadata. Ideal for quickly finding specific titles or exploring options based on partial title matches. Perfect for integration into applications needing comprehensive media search capabilities.

Additional Title Details.name: Additional Title Details
Additional Title Details.description:
Access comprehensive information about movies and TV shows with the Additional Title Details tool. This tool provides a wealth of details including reviews, quotes, plot summaries, voting statistics, trailer URLs, and complete cast and crew data. Ideal for users looking to delve deeper into their favorite titles or discover new ones, this tool ensures you have all the information you need at your fingertips, enhancing your viewing experience or decision-making process for what to watch next.

Note: The tool accepts parameters such as IMDb ID or title name to fetch specific details about the desired movie or TV show.

Title Details.name: Title Details
Title Details.description:
Title Details is an advanced tool designed to fetch detailed information about movies and TV shows. It provides extensive data including IMDb ID, title, genre, runtime, IMDb rating, language, synopsis, type, image URL, and streaming platform availability. This tool is ideal for users seeking in-depth insights into specific titles, helping them make informed viewing choices based on a variety of parameters like availability on streaming services, cast details, and other relevant metadata.

Parameters Description:
- `imdbid`: The unique IMDb identifier for the movie or TV show.
- `title`: The name of the movie or TV show.
- `genre`: The genre(s) associated with the title.
- `runtime`: The duration of the title.
- `imdbrating`: The IMDb rating of the title.
- `language`: The primary language(s) of the title.
- `synopsis`: A brief summary or description of the title.
- `type`: Specifies whether the title is a movie or a TV show.
- `imageurl`: URL to an image or poster of the title.
- `Streaming platforms info`: Information about which streaming services offer the title and in which countries they are available.

Params.name: Params
Params.description: Params is a dynamic tool designed to retrieve a comprehensive array of parameters that can be utilized in conducting Advanced Searches across various databases. This tool simplifies the process of specifying search criteria by offering predefined parameters based on the user's query context, enhancing the accuracy and relevance of search results. Ideal for filtering and refining search outputs in fields such as entertainment, academic research, or any specialized database, Params ensures that users can efficiently narrow down to the most pertinent information or media as per their specific needs.

required_parameters.name: param
required_parameters.description: input 'genre' or 'language' to get array of genre or languages that can be used as filter in advanced search .
